video_title: Panic Time For Utah Jazz?!? TRADE Markkanen To Warriors?!?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Utah Jazz's current roster and rebuilding status
quotes.excerpt: I don't think this is a panic rebuild, they are already in a rebuild.
quotes.quote: They have talent, they are missing two of their best players. They are missing Jaren Jackson and Lauri Markkanen and that is obviously going to hurt. They have Peterson, they have Ace Bailey, but they are still ways away. This is one of the teams I am not surprised because they lost those two guys. This is one of my sleeper picks, it is like my Washington of the East. I thought maybe they could mess around and get in the play-in, be competitive. They have talent. I love the kid since the ball from Ohio State. They have certain guys that I like. They have so much talent where I do not think this is a panic rebuild, they are already in a rebuild. They are basically doing that and now they have acquired these young assets. They have young talent.
quotes.social_post: Chandler Parsons says the Utah Jazz are not in a panic rebuild despite their struggles. He notes they are missing key players like Lauri Markkanen and are focused on developing their young talent.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the Utah Jazz's disappointing start to the season
quotes.excerpt: I won't say high hopes, but I thought this team with the young talent that they've put together
quotes.quote: I won't say high hopes, but I thought this team with the young talent that they have put together in the draft over the last few seasons that this was going to be the year that it started looking like it made sense. Now granted they do have two of their big pieces out of the lineup, but listen, 12 straight losses, man, that is not a good look for Utah. I thought this group would be a little bit more competitive than that with that talent.
quotes.social_post: Lou Williams admits he expected the Utah Jazz to look more competitive this season. He notes that 12 straight losses is not a good look for the franchise.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Utah Jazz's development process and future
quotes.excerpt: I'm not panicking about this situation. This is a group of young guys that have to figure out
quotes.quote: I am not panicking about this situation. This is a group of young guys that have to figure out how to win in this league. They have to go through the experiences that everybody else has had to go through. Keyonte George being a second, third-year player, he is still young figuring it out. Obviously Darren Peterson in his first year, Ace Bailey in his second, and you are missing your two veteran guys in the lineup. So this is kind of expected. They are going through their process of rebuilding. They have their young talent and they have a pretty bright future. So I do not think they are in a panic mode at all. If they are able to go out and get more assets and add more youth to their group, I am pretty sure Danny Ainge would make that happen.
quotes.social_post: DeMarcus Cousins is not panicking about the Jazz. He says this is a group of young guys going through the necessary experience of learning how to win in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Sacramento Kings' roster and coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: I believe in those guys. I believe in Sacramento.
quotes.quote: The Kings, I look at those contracts, that roster, that I would panic. This roster and this group of guys with the potential of the star power that they could possibly turn into, I believe in those guys. I believe in Coach Hardy and Ryan Smith. I believe in those guys. I believe in Sacramento.
quotes.social_post: Chandler Parsons says he believes in the Sacramento Kings roster and coaching staff despite recent concerns. He says I believe in those guys.
